subject: Demo planning: vendor attestation and SSO prerequisites
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@orchard.ai>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orchard.ai
Date: 2028-03-24T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo interest / next steps

Hi Neha,

Thanks — Orchard is excited to see Redwood in action. We have a couple of gating items on our side before we can commit to a live walkthrough with the product team:

- Completed vendor attestation (data handling & subcontractor list)
- Vendor intake questionnaire answered in full
- SOC 2 summary and any SOC coverage notes
- SSO provisioning: at minimum roles and example SAML metadata so our IdP team can create the proper groups

Procurement needs those artifacts to clear the vendor for a demo slot. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the attestation and SOC highlights today? Also please tell us who on your side will own the vendor portal ticket — our security team opened ticket #12345 and will update it as they receive evidence.

If we can get the docs by EOD tomorrow we can keep the demo on 3/28; otherwise we’ll need to push.

Appreciate the help — looping in Procurement/security for visibility.

Thanks,
Sana
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Orchard Health

Attachment: vendor_attestation_template.pdf (requested template)

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@orchard.ai>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-24T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo interest / next steps

Hi Sana — thanks for the clear list. I can own the intake and will coordinate with our SEs, but I want to make sure we deliver precisely what Procurement needs. Quick answers below and next steps: 

- Attestation & questionnaire: we can provide a completed attestation form and the filled vendor questionnaire. Evelyn (cc’d) will attach the files.
- SOC 2: we can share a SOC 2 summary and a snapshot of controls relevant to data processing; full reports are shared under NDA — happy to send the summary now.
- SSO provisioning: SAML metadata and recommended roles require a small configuration from your IdP admin. Our SE suggests a short pre-demo tech sync with your IdP admin to avoid a blocked experience during the live demo.

Because SSO provisioning can take a couple business days depending on your IdP team, if procurement needs the portal ticket closed before the walkthrough we may need to move the live demo. Can you confirm the deadline you mentioned (EOD tomorrow) — do you mean business EOD in Pacific time?

I’ll follow up shortly with the attachments Evelyn prepares.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@orchard.ai>, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-25T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo interest / next steps

Hi Sana and Neha — attaching the artifacts we can provide immediately: vendor_attestation_form_filled.pdf and vendor_questionnaire_answers.xlsx. I’ve also attached a short SOC 2 summary (redwood_saas_soc2_summary.pdf) that highlights the control areas Orchard pointed to in the questionnaire.

Notes on SSO:
- We can produce SAML metadata and a role-mapping guide, but your IdP administrator will need to create the groups and supply us with the AssertionConsumerService URL, or alternatively accept our example metadata.
- Typical turnaround for IdP work on our customers is 24–72 hours depending on the admin’s availability.

Recommendation: keep the planned demo as a product overview / business-use discussion, and schedule a follow-up interactive session (with your IdP admin and our infra engineer) to validate SSO so that the live authenticated flows are fully tested. If Procurement insists on portal closure before an interactive demo, we should reschedule the hands-on session.

Attachments: vendor_attestation_form_filled.pdf; vendor_questionnaire_answers.xlsx; redwood_saas_soc2_summary.pdf

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai

----
On Mar 24, 2028, at 4:05 PM, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Sana — thanks for the clear list...

From: security@orchard.ai <security@orchard.ai>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orchard.ai, sana.patel@orchard.ai
Date: 2028-03-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo intake — portal ticket & evidence

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of items from our side: 

- We received the attestation and the questionnaire — thank you. We still need a short SOC 2 coverage statement specifying whether Redwood permits subprocessors and which services are in-scope; the summary you provided is helpful but Procurement requires one tighter line item for the vendor portal. Can you provide that by EOD?
- The vendor portal ticket (#12345) remains open pending a confirmation of SSO readiness or a plan and timeline. Procurement will not approve a live interactive demo that requires test accounts until the ticket is updated.

Given our internal calendar and travel plans for executive stakeholders, we cannot guarantee the 3/28 slot unless the portal ticket is cleared. For transparency: procurement will hold demos for external validation until the ticket shows ‘evidence uploaded’ and SSO plan accepted.

Please provide the SOC coverage line and an owner for ticket #12345. If you'd prefer, we can move the demo to the week of 4/4 — what availability do you have?

Regards,
Orchard Security Team
security@orchard.ai

Note: portal link — https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/tickets/12345

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: security@orchard.ai, sana.patel@orchard.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-25T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo intake — portal ticket & evidence

Thanks — understood and appreciated. Quick status and next steps from our side: 

1) SOC coverage line: Evelyn will add the explicit subprocessors and in-scope services note by EOD (we’ll upload to ticket #12345 once done).
2) Ticket owner: I will be the owner for the portal ticket and will update it as artifacts are uploaded (ticket #12345).
3) SSO plan: we recommend a short 30–45m pre-demo tech sync between Orchard IdP admin and our infra engineer (Aditya, cc’d). Please share an IdP contact and their availability — Aditya can take the meeting on short notice.

Given Procurement’s gating requirement, let’s provisionally move the interactive demo to the week of 4/4. Two proposed time windows:
- Tue 2028-04-05 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 2028-04-07 14:00–15:00 PT

If either works for Orchard, we’ll reserve the slot and confirm after the portal ticket shows ‘evidence uploaded’. In the meantime we’ll keep the high-level business overview demo on 3/28 as a 30-min executive briefing (no live customer SSO flows) if that still helps your stakeholders.

Resources: vendor portal guide — https://redwood.app/vendor-portal-guide; demo prep notes — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1xyzDemoPrepNotes

Next: Evelyn will post the SOC subprocessors line later today and I’ll update the portal. Marcus will follow up on commercial items once we have the demo date locked.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood_saas_soc2_summary.pdf (updated)
